name: Naples Photography
email_search: Deep search performed: Google Business Profile (no email field public), Birdeye mirror profile JSON (no email field, placeholder logo, status: demo/unclaimed), no Facebook page found for this business, no Instagram account found for this business, no Yelp/WeddingWire/Thumbtack listing found under this exact name and address. No public email surfaced anywhere.
own_site_checked_domains: naplesphotography.com (resolves, HTTP 200, but is an unrelated business: a frameset page titled 'Thome Photography, Naples Florida' that iframes thomephoto.com, operated by photographer Carl J. Thome, not this business)
own_site_check_result: No own website. Google Business Profile shows no Website button (confirmed by the user and re-verified live via Playwright: website field is null). The only web presence found is an unclaimed Birdeye mirror profile (status: demo, isClaimed: 0) whose 'website' field points to http://smileinparadise.wix.com/, which returns a dead Wix 'ConnectYourDomain Error' page, i.e. not a real, working website. The naplesphotography.com domain belongs to a different, unrelated photographer (Thome Photography). Confirmed: no own website.
review_count_source: Re-verified live on Google Maps via Playwright (place_id ChIJhbR_7efj2ogR-rHFZbDndlo): rating 5.0, 16 reviews, matching the figures already confirmed by the user against Google Maps and the unclaimed Birdeye mirror profile (reviews.birdeye.com/naples-photography-170418826811556, which independently confirms name, address, phone and 'not claimed by the business owner').

hours.source: Google Business Profile returned 'Open 24 hours' for every day of the week, which reads as an unverified default rather than real published hours for an appointment-based portrait photographer. Not used on the site; replaced with an honest 'by appointment' statement instead of fabricating hours.
hours.display: By appointment only (call or text to check availability)

review_samples.name: Diana Salinas
review_samples.quote: 10/10! Juan did an amazing job with our maternity pictures! From the music through the photoshoot, flexibility & how absolutely stunning the pictures came out.(Not to mention this is our second time booking with him.) would recommend every time!

review_samples.name: Brittany Napier
review_samples.quote: Absolutely LOVED our experience with Juan! This past week we went to Naples for vacation and our waitress at Tommy Bahama's just so happened to recommend Juan when I asked if she knew anyone local that did photography. Not only was he quick …
review_samples.source: Google Maps, live listing (Maps truncates this review with an ellipsis)

review_samples.name: Andy Walser
review_samples.quote: Juan was amazing! He found us a great location and we loved how the photos turned out. We have an autistic son who is sometimes difficult to photograph…Juan took extra time to capture him in his element where he felt most comfortable and was able to get some fun pictures!

services_notes: No public service menu or price list exists anywhere (no website, no social media, no booking page). Service categories were inferred conservatively, ONLY from what the real Google reviews explicitly describe: maternity photography, family portraits (including patient work with a child on the autism spectrum), and on-location/vacation portrait sessions found through local word of mouth. Engagement/proposal and newborn categories were added to the site ONLY because the downloaded real portfolio photos themselves show those exact session types (a garden proposal, a mother holding a newborn). No prices are published anywhere, so every service on the site uses 'custom quote, just ask' per the adapted-variant rule in PIPELINE.md.

photos.source: Google Maps public photo gallery (lh3.googleusercontent.com gps-cs-s URLs), fetched live via Playwright/Chromium through scripts/maps_research.py, downloaded with curl using a Chrome user agent, verified as real JPEGs with PIL, resized to max 1000px wide at quality 82.

files.description: Elegant couple walking hand in hand on the beach at sunset, dressed up (coral gown and suit); used as the hero image
Family of six (parents, three adult sons and a daughter) posed together on the beach at sunset
Mother in a pink blouse holding her sleeping newborn baby on the beach at sunset
Couple playfully splashing water at each other in the ocean at golden hour, used as the signature-session feature image
Dramatic, colorful sunset over a Naples beach pier with storm clouds, no people, used as an atmospheric wide gallery tile
Older couple kissing while standing on beach rocks at sunset
A real marriage proposal captured in a lush garden setting, man kneeling
Family of seven in white tops and jeans running through shallow waves on a palm-lined beach
Close, intimate couple portrait (forehead to forehead) in a natural wooded setting

discarded: A family-of-four photo taken on a Third Street South Naples sidewalk: discarded for the site gallery because readable third-party shop signage ('Gift Shop', 'Salon de Thé') is visible in the background, which would distract from Naples Photography's own branding, even though the shot itself is technically fine.
photos.curation_note: All 10 photos downloaded from the live Google Maps gallery were reviewed one by one (not chosen by filename). All are technically strong, in-focus, well-composed and well-lit professional portrait work; none were blurry, poorly framed, or screenshots with text overlays, so none needed to be discarded for quality, only the one with distracting third-party signage.

template_base: templates/dark/index.html (the Mizū dark exemplar, motion v2+v3)
palette: Custom warm gold/champagne on near-black editorial background (bg #120f0d, accent-deep #d8b37a, accent-mid #b08f5c), adapted from the exemplar's palette tokens to fit a photography-studio brand while keeping the merktop-badge gold untouched.
build_variant: Adapted variant per PIPELINE.md Fase 3 point 5: no published pricing (every service shows 'custom quote, just ask'), no WhatsApp/Instagram CTA (neither channel is confirmed to exist for this business), CTA is call (tel:) and text (sms:) to the real Google-listed phone number instead. Real street address was confirmed, so a live Google Maps embed is used (unlike variants with no confirmed address, which use a photo instead).
notes: The repository already contained a thin, auto-generated placeholder for this exact slug (a content.json built from the 'dark-v2' skeleton, with generic boilerplate copy like 'Check the public listing, see real photos and contact the business directly' and the sunset landscape photo mislabeled as the business logo). That placeholder and its .assetsignore were removed and replaced with this fully researched, hand-built, photo-curated site per this task's explicit instructions (start from templates/dark/index.html directly, like the outside-in-handyman-portcharlotte reference). No email was found anywhere after deep search, so outreach is pending_manual via phone/text.
